reviews.review_description:
So there I was at 2 AM, wearing my Meta Quest VR headset, playing the scariest horror game known to mankind. The lights were off, the volume was maxed out, and I was fighting for my life.
Suddenly, a monster jumped out of nowhere and screamed directly into my soul.
“AAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!”
I jumped so hard I nearly punched a hole through my ceiling.
But little did I know, my dog had been sneaking up behind me like a furry assassin.
Before I could even recover, that little menace took a bite out of my butt!
“YEEEEEOOOOOWWW!”
I launched across the room, screaming like I was getting chased by the entire Marvel universe. My Meta Quest headset was flying around, my controllers were hitting the walls, and my dog ran away like HE had just been attacked.
And then it happened.
I PEED MYSELF.
I stood there in complete silence, still wearing my VR headset, staring into the virtual darkness while my dog sat across the room wagging his tail.
I slowly took off the headset and looked at him.
“BRO. YOU COULD'VE JUST BARKED.”
He barked once.
I swear he was laughing at me.
The next morning, I told everyone what happened, and nobody believed me. Apparently, getting jump-scared by a VR monster, bitten by your own dog, and peeing yourself all in the same five seconds sounds impossible.
But I know the truth.
